collection.title: Mini Clubman 2012 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mini Clubman 2012 to 2014 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Clubman, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
